label: MGS2 — otage anonyme grisonnant de Shell 1, assis
episode: Metal Gear Solid 2 / capture HD Edition
scope: Une variante civile anonyme assise, observée à 132–134 s ; le groupe des otages reste ouvert.
qaNotes: Capture native de MGS2 HD présentée par IGN, non certifiée comme capture PS2 originale.
Sujet ciblé : homme anonyme grisonnant en costume sombre, assis au sol contre le grillage, visible dans la deuxième rangée, première et deuxième vignettes de la feuille 7 (132–134 s).
Ames n’est pas ciblé ; ce personnage anonyme ne reçoit aucun nom ou rôle inventé.
La pose civile assise est conservée ; aucun costume de combat ni équipement n’est ajouté.
Les vignettes natives limitent la précision des petits détails du visage, de la cravate et des chaussures ; aucune certification 1:1.
prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent-background 2D game sprite of exactly the gray-haired anonymous male Shell 1 hostage shown in these native Metal Gear Solid 2 HD gameplay storyboard references. This is a faithful visual reconstruction of the observed civilian, not a new character design. PRIMARY TARGET: in the FIRST reference sheet, the second row, first and second cells (video time about 132–134 seconds), the gray-haired man in the charcoal business suit seated on the floor in front of the wire-mesh divider. Use the same subject, not the bald hostage from the first row and not the armed player. Preserve the existing seated pose, slight slouch, bowed/turned head, arms held behind his back, bent knees with both trouser legs and black dress shoes visible toward lower right. Keep the dark charcoal jacket and matching trousers, light shirt collar, narrow dark tie, short graying hair, restrained original PS2-era low-poly proportions and palette. Keep his original camera-facing three-quarter orientation; do not rotate him into a standing fighter. Use crisp restrained videogame sprite rendering, simple low-poly shading, no new accessories, no weapons, no tactical armor, no handcuffs invented where not visible, no invented name tag, no decorative outline. Reconstruct only the visible subject with both shoes and complete head in the canvas; allow about 10 percent transparent margin around the complete seated silhouette. Remove the room, wire mesh, pistol held by the player, interface, subtitles, IGN watermark, floor and shadow. Exactly one complete civilian subject, no duplicates, no collage, no sheet, no text. Genuine native alpha transparency, no opaque checkerboard or colored background. Do not add photorealistic detail that the game model does not contain.

label: The Twin Snakes — Kenneth Baker assis après sa libération

scope: Kenneth Baker, pose civile assise après libération, d’après la cinématique native ; une pose observée, pas un corps de combattant.
qaNotes: Références natives de la version GameCube The Twin Snakes, corps assis visible après la libération de Baker ; ne pas réattribuer à son modèle PS1.
